description: Dataset importance categories. Classifies each dataset by its priority within the project without implementing ranking logic. Priority categories describe relative importance for collection and processing order.

railway_zones.rationale: Foundational reference dataset. All other datasets depend on the zone hierarchy.

railway_divisions.rationale: Second-level reference dataset. Station codes and downstream datasets depend on divisions.

station_codes.rationale: Core identifier dataset. Station master and station status depend on station codes.

station_master.rationale: Primary data product. Contains comprehensive station records with geographic data.

train_master.rationale: Primary data product. Contains comprehensive train schedule and route information.

station_categories.rationale: Classification reference. Useful for filtering and categorization but not a dependency for other datasets.

station_status.rationale: Operational metadata. Important for live status but not a dependency for other datasets.

notes: Dataset priority metadata registry. Classifies datasets by importance category. No ranking logic or scoring engine is implemented. No APIs, URLs, or live analysis is performed.
